feeds.title: Feminist Book Club Blog
feeds.description: Find the show notes and blog posts for Feminist Book Club all in one place! Feminist Book Club is the premier online hub for intersectional readers, encouraging resistance through reading.

feeds.title: The Feminist Bibliothecary Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the page of the Feminist Bibliothecary! The Feminist Bibliothecary is here to provide you with commentary, recommendations for, and access to various types of media (particularly books) based upon intersectional feminist principles.

feeds.title: Seattle Book Mama » Feminist Fiction
feeds.description: Where Books Are for Everybody! Posts about feminist fiction written by seattlebookmama.

feeds.title: Astoria Feminist Book Group
feeds.description: An intersectional feminist reading and discussion group in Astoria, Queens, NYC. We're a book group established in February 2017. Our focus is on an intersectional exploration of women's rights and status worldwide.

feeds.title: Little Feminist Blog
feeds.description: Our team of educators and parents search high and low for the most amazing diverse books. We read through hundreds! Find out what we're talking about, the latest news, and all the books your Little Feminist should be reading.

feeds.title: Feminist Books for Kids
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Crystal, a writer, marketer, activist, and parent. I believe that one of the best tools we have for raising empathetic kids is children's literature. Diverse books show kids like mine that there is more to the world than what they experience. Check out the blog for more information.

feeds.title: Rise Feminist Books Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Rise: A Feminist Book Project for Ages 0-18 blog! We create an annual booklist of the best feminist books for young readers, ages birth through 18. We are part of the Feminist Task Force of the Social Responsibilities Round Table of the American Library Association.

feeds.title: Never Judge a Book by its Cover » Feminism
feeds.description: A bright UK Book Blog reviewing and promoting a wide range of fiction. Never Judge a Book by it Cover was created back in 2012. It's a UK based review site, focusing on young and new adult titles. (possibly the odd adult book as well.) These have been reviewed by myself, Emma, and are an honest review and reflection of the novel sent by the publishers.

feeds.title: Celebration of Books » Feminism
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Celebration of Books! I'm Sarah, a thirty-something bookstore manager and book buyer at an independent bookstore in the Philadelphia suburbs. I love my job, I love books, and I hope you'll find a book or two here that you'll enjoy as well!

feeds.title: UEA Feminist Book Club
feeds.description: We are a group of people who love books and want to celebrate feminism through reading! We'll get together to explore literature you love and discover new and exciting reads!

feeds.title: Second Story Press Blog
feeds.description: Second Story Press was co-founded in 1988 by Margie Wolfe and three other women dedicated to publishing feminist-inspired books for adults and young readers. We are proud that for over 30 years we have been publishing great books that matter. Our list spans adult fiction and nonfiction; children's fiction, nonfiction and picture books; and young adult fiction and nonfiction.
